title: Group libvips unknown file format errors in Sentry
body:
On Glitchtip in production, we get a new issue created for every bogus avatar file. This is because the error message includes the path of the tempfile that Active Storage downloaded the blob to, which is random, so every occurrence is reported as a separate issue. We can fingerprint them by file extension instead.

This is something that unfortunately I can't test myself, within any reasonable amount of effort! But maybe @tomhughes you might want to try it and see if it works. If not, no worries, the Glitchtip issues disappear automatically and will hopefully be taken care of in #7546 and followups anyway.
